zh: 週二（11/24）美股分歧：道瓊收 50,021.91 點（+0.86%），重回 5 萬點之上（11/19 曾跌破，是 6 月以來首次）；標普 500 約收 7,201 至 7,202 點（-0.5%）；那斯達克收 23,733.54 點（-1.5%）。盤中那指一度跌逾 2%，尾盤收斂。晶片股回吐週一 Nvidia 帶動的大漲，資金轉向醫療與必需消費等防禦類股，所以道瓊比那指強；各家媒體的標普數字差一兩點，我沒有查到官方收盤表。
en: Tuesday (Nov. 24) split the market: the Dow closed at 50,021.91 (+0.86%), back above 50,000 after breaking below it on Nov. 19 for the first time since June; the S&P 500 closed near 7,201-7,202 (-0.5%); the Nasdaq closed at 23,733.54 (-1.5%). The Nasdaq was down more than 2% at one point. Chip stocks gave back part of Monday's Nvidia-led surge while money rotated into healthcare and staples, so the Dow beat the Nasdaq. Outlets differ by a point or two on the S&P; I did not find an official closing table.

stocks.n: 那斯達克 100 ETF，那指 -1.5%
標普 500 ETF，指數約 -0.5%

zh: Nvidia（NVDA）週二跟著回吐：盤中一度跌約 8.5%，行情列顯示約 -5.9%、約 155 美元，週一收盤是 165.05 美元（單日 +31.5%）。華爾街日報轉述，黃仁勳在週二員工大會上道歉，並說正在接受心理治療（我沒有查到原文）；董事長仍由 Harvey Jones 擔任。市場現在看的是治理與出口調查風險；調查仍在進行，不等於已有不當行為的結論。
en: Nvidia (NVDA) gave back part of Monday's gain: it was down about 8.5% at one point and about 5.9% (near $155) in a later quote, versus Monday's $165.05 close (+31.5% on the day). The Wall Street Journal, as relayed by a secondary site, reported Jensen Huang apologized at a Tuesday town hall and said he is in therapy (I did not find the original). Harvey Jones remains chairman. The market is now weighing governance and export-probe risk; investigations are ongoing and are not findings of wrongdoing.

stocks.n: 半導體 ETF，晶片股回吐的代表

zh: Anthropic（ANT）上市第四個交易日跌破 83 美元發行價：路透稱午盤約 -13.4%、報 76 美元，另一個時點報 79.08 美元，Motley Fool 的行情列約 81.91 美元（-6.5%）；這些是不同時間點的數字，不是互相矛盾。華爾街日報指出，在首日市值逾 750 億美元的 IPO 中，只有 Facebook 更快跌破發行價。跌破發行價只代表 IPO 買家的溢價消失，不能直接推出公司價值。
en: Anthropic (ANT) fell below its $83 IPO price on its fourth trading day: Reuters had it down about 13.4% at $76 around midday, another snapshot showed $79.08, and Motley Fool's ticker showed about $81.91 (-6.5%); these are different moments, not contradictions. The Wall Street Journal noted that among IPOs valued above $75 billion at debut, only Facebook fell below its offer price faster. Trading below the offer price removes the IPO premium; it does not by itself say what the business is worth.

stocks.n: 發行價 83 美元，午盤約 76 至 82 美元

zh: 跨資產：布蘭特約 89.1 美元、WTI 約 80 美元，早盤各跌約 0.3%，路透稱原油接近三個月低點，但荷莫茲海峽航運風險仍在；現貨黃金午盤約 3,568 美元（跌約 2.3%，數字依時點而異）；10 年期美債殖利率約 4.92%；比特幣約 59,832 美元（-2.1%）。另外，Conference Board 11 月消費者信心升到 103.3（修正後前值 91.9，預期約 92.1 至 92.4），路透稱是近兩年新高。殖利率這麼高、信心又這麼強，是週三 PCE 前市場最在意的組合。
en: Cross-asset: Brent was near $89.1 and WTI about $80, each down about 0.3% early, with Reuters noting oil near a three-month low despite Strait of Hormuz shipping risk; spot gold was about $3,568 at midday (down about 2.3%, depending on the timestamp); the 10-year Treasury yield was about 4.92%; Bitcoin was about $59,832 (-2.1%). Separately, the Conference Board's November consumer confidence rose to 103.3 (revised prior 91.9, forecast about 92.1-92.4), a near two-year high per Reuters. High yields plus strong confidence is the combination the market is watching before Wednesday's PCE.

stocks.n: 原油 ETF，布蘭特約 89.1、WTI 約 80
黃金 ETF，現貨約 3,568 美元
長天期美債 ETF，10 年期殖利率約 4.92%

zh: Dell（DELL）週二盤後公布 Q3：調整後 EPS 9.45 美元（預期 6.59）、營收 549.4 億美元（預期 493.2 億），營收年增逾一倍；AI 伺服器出貨約 220 億美元（+291%），積壓訂單 1,323 億美元，下一年度 AI 伺服器預測上調到 780 億美元（預期 740 億）。Q4 財測 EPS 8.40、營收約 563 億，也高於預期；另授權 250 億美元回購。弱點是個人電腦部門營收 128.9 億，低於預期 143.3 億（記憶體漲價壓抑需求）。CNBC 稱盤後上漲；另有行情顯示的數字不一致，開盤前請再看。
en: Dell (DELL) reported fiscal Q3 after Tuesday's close: adjusted EPS $9.45 (expected $6.59) and revenue $54.94 billion (expected $49.32 billion), with sales more than doubling year over year; AI server shipments were about $22 billion (+291%), the backlog is $132.3 billion, and the AI server forecast for the coming year rose to $78 billion (vs. $74 billion expected). The Q4 guide of $8.40 EPS on about $56.3 billion revenue was also above estimates, and Dell authorized a $25 billion buyback. The weak spot was PCs: $12.89 billion versus $14.33 billion expected, as higher memory prices hurt demand. CNBC said shares rose after hours; other quotes conflict, so recheck before the open.

stocks.n: EPS 9.45 對預期 6.59，AI 伺服器約 220 億美元（+291%）

zh: 兩個相反的財報反應：Analog Devices（ADI）週二盤前公布，財測讓市場失望，Motley Fool 午盤快照約 -17% 至 -19%（預告的共識是 EPS 3.89、營收 43.2 億美元；我沒有查到實際數字）；百貨 Kohl's（KSS）Q3 優於預期，午盤約 +17% 至 +19%；Pinterest（PINS）宣布調整高階主管薪酬架構，約 +12%。同一個大盤裡，財測比當季數字重要，低預期的零售股只要超標就會被獎勵。
en: Two opposite earnings reactions: Analog Devices (ADI) reported before the open and its outlook disappointed, with Motley Fool's midday snapshot showing about -17% to -19% (consensus going in was EPS $3.89 on $4.32 billion revenue; I did not find the actual numbers); department store Kohl's (KSS) beat on Q3 and was up about 17-19% at midday; Pinterest (PINS) announced changes to its executive compensation structure and rose about 12%. In the same tape, guidance mattered more than the quarter, and low-expectation retailers were rewarded for beating.

stocks.n: 財測失望，午盤約 -17% 至 -19%
Q3 優於預期，午盤約 +17% 至 +19%
調整高階薪酬架構，午盤約 +12%

zh: 盤後三家：HP Inc.（HPQ）調整後 EPS 0.83（預期 0.75）、營收 160.0 億美元（預期 154.3 億），全年展望偏正面，盤後約 +9%；Autodesk（ADSK）EPS 3.20（預期 3.07）並小幅上調全年財測，卻約 -4%；Workday（WDAY）EPS 2.82（預期 2.75）且上調全年，但 Q4 訂閱營收財測略軟，約 -4%。來源是 Investing.com 的盤後速報，早期盤後數字可能變動。
en: Three after-hours reports: HP Inc. (HPQ) posted adjusted EPS of $0.83 (expected $0.75) on revenue of $16.00 billion (expected $15.43 billion) with an upbeat full-year outlook, and rose about 9%; Autodesk (ADSK) earned $3.20 (expected $3.07) and edged up full-year guidance but fell about 4%; Workday (WDAY) earned $2.82 (expected $2.75) and raised the full year, but slightly soft Q4 subscription guidance sent it down about 4%. The source is an Investing.com after-hours roundup; early after-hours moves can change.

stocks.n: EPS 0.83 對預期 0.75，盤後約 +9%
EPS 3.20 對預期 3.07，盤後約 -4%
EPS 2.82 對預期 2.75，Q4 訂閱財測偏軟，約 -4%

zh: 週三 11/25 早上 8:30 同時公布 10 月核心 PCE（預期月增約 0.3%，年增各家約 3.2% 至 3.3%）、Q3 GDP 二次估計（預期 3.5%，初值 3.4%）、初領失業金（預期約 20 萬）與耐久財訂單；下午 2:00 有 Fed 褐皮書。這輪 Fed 的方向是升息：多個來源稱 12 月 9 日升息 25 基點的機率約 91% 至 99%（數字因來源與日期而異）。所以市場在賭的是「不要更熱」，不是「降息」。
en: On Wednesday Nov. 25 at 8:30 a.m. ET, October core PCE (forecast about +0.3% m/m and roughly 3.2-3.3% y/y), the second Q3 GDP estimate (forecast 3.5%, first 3.4%), weekly jobless claims (forecast about 200,000) and durable goods orders all land together; the Fed's Beige Book follows at 2:00 p.m. The Fed's bias in this cycle is toward hikes: several sources put the odds of a 25 bp hike on Dec. 9 at roughly 91% to 99% (figures vary by source and date). So the market is hoping for no hotter, not for cuts.

stocks.n: 7 至 10 年期美債 ETF，對 PCE 與升息預期敏感
區域銀行 ETF，利率路徑與存放款利差

zh: Conference Board 11 月消費者信心指數 103.3，修正後的 10 月為 91.9，預期約 92.1 至 92.4，路透稱是近兩年高點；S&P CoreLogic 全國房價 9 月年增 2.1%，與 8 月持平。信心強、殖利率約 4.92%，讓「升息要繼續」的說法更站得住腳。但信心指數是問卷，不等於消費；要看週三 PCE 與假期銷售才能確認。
en: The Conference Board's November consumer confidence index came in at 103.3 versus a revised 91.9 in October and a forecast of about 92.1-92.4, a near two-year high per Reuters; the S&P CoreLogic national home price index rose 2.1% y/y in September, matching August. Strong confidence plus a 10-year yield near 4.92% makes the case for continued Fed hikes more credible. But confidence is a survey, not spending; Wednesday's PCE and holiday sales are the real checks.

stocks.n: 非必需消費 ETF，消費信心直接受惠族群
必需消費 ETF，防禦輪動中表現較穩

zh: 週二盤前傳出美國準備對中國與數十個「損害美國企業」的國家提高關稅（我沒找到原始報導，來源是盤前行情摘要），股市隨之走弱。背景：7 月美國依 301 條款對約 60 個貿易夥伴課徵兩位數關稅（中國 12.5%），並有報導稱官員打算把對中關稅重建回 20%；另有針對 16 國產能過剩的 301 調查尚未結案。結果與時程未定，不要把傳聞當成已生效的政策。
en: Before Tuesday's open, headlines said the U.S. was preparing to raise tariffs on China and dozens of other countries seen as harming American companies (I did not find the original report; the source is a premarket summary), and stocks weakened. Background: in July the U.S. imposed double-digit Section 301 tariffs on about 60 trading partners (China at 12.5%), and reports said officials intend to rebuild China tariffs to 20%; a separate Section 301 probe into overproduction by 16 countries is unfinished. Outcome and timing are open; treat this as a report, not policy in force.

stocks.n: 中國大型股 ETF，對中關稅傳聞最直接
中國網路股 ETF，貿易與監管消息敏感

zh: 半導體是週二最先被賣的板塊：ADI 因財測失望約 -17% 至 -19%、Nvidia 回吐約 6%；費半相關 ETF 的當日數字我沒查到。週一漲最兇的族群（SMH 盤中漲逾 16%）週二最先回吐，更像情緒盤而不是趨勢轉折；是否站穩，要看 Dell 這類「AI 需求真實」的財報能不能把買盤帶回來。
en: Semiconductors were sold first on Tuesday: ADI fell about 17-19% on a disappointing outlook and Nvidia gave back about 6%; I did not find the day's figure for semiconductor ETFs. The group that rose most on Monday (SMH was up more than 16% intraday) was the first to give back, which looks more like a sentiment trade than a trend change; whether it holds depends on whether results like Dell's, which show AI demand is real, can bring buyers back.

stocks.n: 半導體 ETF，週一盤中漲逾 16% 後回吐
類比晶片，財測失望

zh: 醫療是週二領漲的防禦類股之一。Sanofi（SNY）宣布以每股 175 美元現金收購 Insmed（INSM），總額約 410 億美元（376 億歐元）；標的包括 Brinsupri（brensocatib）、Arikayce，以及第三期的 TPIP（吸入式 treprostinil palmitil）。媒體先前的說法是 Sanofi 要面對 Dupixent 的專利壓力。我沒有查到 INSM 當日漲幅與交易的完成條件。
en: Healthcare was among the leading defensive sectors on Tuesday. Sanofi (SNY) announced it will buy Insmed (INSM) for $175 per share in cash, about $41.0 billion (EUR 37.6 billion); the deal includes Brinsupri (brensocatib), Arikayce and the phase 3 TPIP (inhaled treprostinil palmitil). Earlier press coverage framed it against Sanofi's Dupixent patent pressure. I did not find INSM's move on the day or the closing conditions.

stocks.n: 收購方，每股 175 美元現金、約 410 億美元
被收購方，Brinsupri、Arikayce
醫療類股 ETF，週二防禦輪動

zh: 大型科技也不是一致往下：Motley Fool 午盤行情列顯示 Apple（AAPL）約 +1.4%（354.07 美元）、Microsoft（MSFT）約 +0.7%（496.13 美元），而 Meta、Amazon、Alphabet 約跌 1.1% 至 1.3%，Tesla 約 -0.2%。AI 資本支出的買家與受益者在同一天走出不同方向，說明市場在挑「誰拿得到利潤」，而不是整體賣出科技。這只是午盤快照，不是收盤數字。
en: Big tech did not move as one: Motley Fool's midday ticker showed Apple (AAPL) up about 1.4% ($354.07) and Microsoft (MSFT) up about 0.7% ($496.13), while Meta, Amazon and Alphabet were down roughly 1.1% to 1.3% and Tesla about 0.2%. Buyers and beneficiaries of AI capex went opposite ways on the same day, so the market is picking who captures the profit rather than selling tech wholesale. This is a midday snapshot, not closing data.

zh: 這則是判讀，不是行情。我沒有查到羅素 2000 週二的收盤。能確認的最近一筆是 11/17：收 2,701.87 點（-1.5%），報導把原因歸給 Nvidia 與其他 AI 個股拖累。小型股對利率敏感（浮動利率債務多），而 10 年期殖利率在 4.9% 上下、市場押 12 月升息，所以週三 PCE 對小型股的影響，可能比對大型科技股更直接。
en: This is interpretation, not a quote. I did not find Tuesday's Russell 2000 close. The latest figure I can confirm is Nov. 17: 2,701.87 (-1.5%), which a report blamed on Nvidia and other AI stocks. Small caps are rate-sensitive (more floating-rate debt), and with the 10-year near 4.9% and a December hike priced, Wednesday's PCE may matter more directly to small caps than to large tech.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF，利率敏感度的代表
標普小型股 600 ETF，獲利品質篩選較嚴

zh: Kohl's（KSS）：美國中價位百貨連鎖。Q3 財報優於預期，午盤漲約 17% 至 19%（Motley Fool）。這種單日大漲的零售股要分清兩件事：是營運真的改善，還是預期太低、空單回補。我沒有查今日市值與空單比率，也不確定財測有沒有調升，所以只當事件記錄；下一個驗證點是假期銷售與下一季財測。
en: Kohl's (KSS) is a mid-priced U.S. department store chain. Its Q3 beat sent shares up about 17-19% at midday (Motley Fool). With a one-day jump like this, separate two stories: real operating improvement versus low expectations and short covering. I did not check today's market cap or short interest, and I am not sure guidance was raised, so I treat it only as an event; the next checks are holiday sales and next-quarter guidance.

stocks.n: Q3 優於預期，午盤約 +17% 至 +19%
零售 ETF，假期銷售的觀察窗

zh: 判讀：感恩節週成交量薄，週四休市、週五 13:00 收盤。薄量時小型股買賣價差變大，一筆大單就能把價格推開，所以這幾天看到小型股「大漲大跌」，先想是不是量能不足，再想基本面。這也是為什麼小型股的報價在假期週比較不可靠；做研究線索可以，別拿假期週的單日價格當結論。
en: Interpretation: Thanksgiving week volume is thin, with markets closed Thursday and closing at 1:00 p.m. Friday. In thin trading, small-cap bid-ask spreads widen and one large order can push the price, so when small caps swing hard this week, first ask whether it is a volume effect, then whether it is fundamentals. That is why small-cap quotes are less reliable in holiday weeks; fine for research leads, but do not treat a single holiday-week print as a conclusion.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF（另一檔），薄量時價差較寬
小型股 ETF，成分廣、流動性分層明顯

zh: 判讀：小型股的估值方法跟大型股不一樣。羅素 2000 有相當比例公司沒有獲利（常見說法約四成，我沒有查今年的數字），本益比常常算不出來，所以改看 EV／營收、自由現金流、淨負債對 EBITDA。這張的用意是提醒：看到小型股的「便宜」，先確認是用什麼指標算的；還有，負債高的小型公司，升息環境下風險會被放大。
en: Interpretation: small caps are valued differently from large caps. A sizable share of the Russell 2000 has no earnings (a common estimate is about 40%; I did not check this year's figure), so P/E often cannot be computed, and analysts use EV/sales, free cash flow and net debt to EBITDA instead. The point: when a small cap looks cheap, check which metric says so; and in a hiking environment, highly indebted small companies carry amplified risk.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 價值 ETF，價值型小型股
標普小型股 600 ETF，要求獲利的篩選

zh: 標題顯示 SharkNinja（SN）將被納入標普 500，同一則提到 AES 的 334 億美元收購接近完成（我只看到標題，沒有讀內文，細節以公告為準）。中型股被納入標普 500 通常會帶來指數基金的被動買盤，這是機制，不是基本面變化；AES 若確定被收購，則是公用事業與再生能源的併購題材。
en: A headline says SharkNinja (SN) will be added to the S&P 500, and the same item says a $33.4 billion buyout of AES is nearing completion (I only saw the headline and did not read the article; check the announcement for details). When a mid-cap joins the S&P 500, index funds typically add passive demand; that is mechanics, not a change in fundamentals. If AES is confirmed as a target, it is a utilities and renewables M&A theme.

stocks.n: 家電品牌，標題稱將納入標普 500
電力與再生能源，標題稱 334 億美元收購接近完成

zh: Global Net Lease（GNL，NYSE）：持有長約淨租賃商業不動產的 REIT。InsiderPrint 顯示 7 名內部人在 11/19 至 11/20 合計買進約 63.6 萬美元，均價約 6.04 美元，包括執行長 Weil 20 萬、董事 Richardson 15 萬。第二訊號：Q3（11/4 公布）調高全年 AFFO 財測到每股 0.83 至 0.85 美元，並回購 660 萬股、約 5,850 萬美元。為什麼可能被忽視：營收規模縮小、股價從 8 月約 8.94 美元降到約 7 美元，分析師覆蓋數我沒查。風險：淨負債對 EBITDA 一度升到 7.7 倍（目標 6.5 至 6.9）、5,820 萬美元減損（多為辦公室資產）、入住率 96%（前季 97%）、回購動用循環信貸。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Global Net Lease (GNL, NYSE) is a REIT holding long-lease net lease commercial properties. InsiderPrint shows seven insiders bought about $636,000 on Nov. 19-20 at an average of about $6.04, including CEO Weil ($200,000) and director Richardson ($150,000). Second signal: Q3 (Nov. 4) raised full-year AFFO guidance to $0.83-$0.85 per share and bought back 6.6 million shares for about $58.5 million. Why possibly neglected: a shrinking revenue base and a share price down from about $8.94 in August to around $7; I did not check analyst coverage. Risks: net debt/EBITDA temporarily 7.7x (target 6.5-6.9x), $58.2 million of impairments (mostly office), occupancy 96% (97% prior quarter), and buybacks funded by the revolver. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: PureCycle Technologies（PCT，Nasdaq）：回收聚丙烯（PP）再生樹脂 PureFive，主力工廠在俄亥俄 Ironton。內部人訊號：3 人在 11/13 至 11/20 合計買進約 55.9 萬美元，執行長 Olson 約 37.2 萬、董事長 Musa 約 9.8 萬，InsiderPrint 列的均價約 1.68 美元（這個價格我覺得偏低，要回 Form 4 核對）。這是財報大幅低於預期後的買進：Q3（11/4）營收僅 230 萬美元（預期約 1,035 萬）、調整後 EBITDA -2,800 萬，紐澤西延長食品接觸豁免，約 15 項食品接觸專案、年量約 5,000 萬磅推到 2027。可看的：Ironton 產量 520 萬磅（季增 14%）、流動性 1.93 億美元另有 2 億美元未動用循環額度。風險：損益兩平目標被第三方分析認為已放棄、成長資本支出暫停。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: PureCycle Technologies (PCT, Nasdaq) makes PureFive recycled polypropylene resin, mainly at its Ironton, Ohio plant. Insider signal: three insiders bought about $559,000 on Nov. 13-20, including CEO Olson (about $372,000) and chair Musa (about $98,000), at an average of about $1.68 per InsiderPrint (that price looks low to me; verify against Form 4). This is buying after a big miss: Q3 (Nov. 4) revenue was only $2.3 million (about $10.35 million expected), adjusted EBITDA was -$28.0 million, and New Jersey's extension of its food-contact exemption pushed about 15 food-contact programs (about 50 million pounds a year) into 2027. Positives: Ironton output of 5.2 million pounds (+14% sequentially) and $193 million of liquidity plus an undrawn $200 million revolver. Risks: third-party analysis says the breakeven target was dropped, and growth spending is on hold. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: Csquare（CSQR）：客戶體驗外包（BPO）與聯絡中心服務商，剛 IPO（財報有 IPO 相關費用）。3 人在 11/11 合計買進約 45.4 萬美元，包括執行長 Mullee 約 24.7 萬、董事 Kelley 約 17.2 萬、財務長約 3.5 萬，均價約 17.75 美元。第二訊號：Q3 營收 3.023 億美元（+25.6%）、調整後 EBITDA 1.321 億（+44%、利潤率 47.8%）、單季新增訂單創高 6,610 萬、已簽約年化積壓約 1.14 億。Panabee 稱全年 EBITDA 財測上調到中點 4.95 億，EarningsWhispers 則說財測符合預期，來源不一。為什麼可能被忽視：新上市，覆蓋與流通量我沒查。風險：淨損 8,810 萬（含 IPO 費用 5,860 萬）、EPS -0.58 低於預期 -0.50、利息費用。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Csquare (CSQR) provides outsourced customer experience (BPO) and contact center services and appears recently IPO'd (results include IPO-related costs). Three insiders bought about $454,000 on Nov. 11, including CEO Mullee (about $247,000), director Kelley (about $172,000) and the CFO (about $35,000), at an average of about $17.75. Second signal: Q3 revenue of $302.3 million (+25.6%), adjusted EBITDA of $132.1 million (+44%, 47.8% margin), record quarterly bookings of $66.1 million and about $114 million of contracted annualized backlog. Panabee says full-year EBITDA guidance was raised to a $495 million midpoint, while EarningsWhispers calls guidance in line; sources differ. Why possibly neglected: new listing; I did not check coverage or float. Risks: net loss of $88.1 million (including $58.6 million of IPO costs), EPS of -$0.58 vs. -$0.50 expected, and interest expense. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

Three insiders bought about $898,000 on Nov. 9-12, including director Bortz (about $672,000), CEO Coleman (about $182,000) and president Lammas (about $44,000), at an average of about $9.06 (InsiderPrint). This is a research lead, not investment advice.

en: Kodiak Gas Services (KGS, NYSE) provides natural gas compression and also power generation rentals. Three directors bought about $544,000 on Nov. 11-12 (Darden about $450,000) at an average of about $44.80. Second signal: Q3 (Nov. 9) adjusted EBITDA of $224.5 million (+28.5%), compression fleet utilization of 98.3%, and full-year EBITDA guidance raised to $840-860 million; but a finviz headline says the stock stays near its lows because the power ramp is delayed (2026 power additions trimmed to 29 MW and power growth capex cut to $350-400 million, per a third-party write-up). It is not a small company, so this reads more as an undervalued transition story than double neglect. Risks: about $2.8 billion of debt (3.1x leverage), power execution and the energy cycle. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

en: Interpretation: InsiderPrint's own statistics show that of 6,290 insider buys since 2020, only 46% beat the S&P 500 over 90 days; this week it saw 421 buys and 965 sells, about $343 million bought versus $5.48 billion sold, and 46 cluster buys (three or more insiders). So insider buying is a lead worth questioning, not a buy signal; small amounts (for example four Crescent Capital BDC insiders buying about $183,000 combined), purchases tied to fund financings, or one-day buys carry even less information.

zh: 判讀：為什麼政要申報不能當成買賣訊號。一、法定 45 天內申報，你看到的是一到兩個月前的決定，之後股價可能已經大幅變動；二、金額只有區間（例如 1,001 至 15,000 美元），所以我只能給區間合計；三、很多是配偶或信託帳戶執行；四、選擇權要看履約價與到期日才有意義；五、跟單者買到的是別人 45 天前的價位。這個頻道只寫「誰申報了什麼、結構代表什麼假設」，不暗示任何動機。
en: Interpretation: why congressional disclosures are not a trading signal. One, filings are due within 45 days, so you see a decision made one to two months ago and the price may have moved a lot since; two, amounts are only ranges (for example $1,001 to $15,000), so I can only give combined ranges; three, many trades are made by spouses or trusts; four, options only mean something with the strike and expiry; five, anyone copying buys at a price set 45 days earlier. This channel only states who filed what and what assumption the structure implies, and implies no motive.

zh: 今天最值得注意的是兩個訊號互相拉扯。Dell 給了這波 AI 回檔裡最硬的「需求是真的」證據：AI 伺服器約 220 億美元（+291%）、積壓 1,323 億、EPS 9.45 對預期 6.59；但同一天 ADI 因財測失望重挫、Anthropic 跌破發行價，Nvidia 回吐 6%。市場問的已經不只是需求有沒有，而是誰拿得到利潤、資金能不能撐住——Dell 自己也說每張 AI 訂單都要審查客戶取得資本的管道。如果 Dell 盤後大漲、隔天開盤卻被賣，那代表 AI 交易的賣壓來自倉位還是基本面？討論按鈕在最後一頁。
en: Two signals pulled against each other today. Dell delivered the hardest evidence yet in this AI pullback that demand is real: AI servers of about $22 billion (+291%), a $132.3 billion backlog and EPS of $9.45 versus $6.59 expected; but on the same day ADI plunged on its outlook, Anthropic fell below its IPO price and Nvidia gave back about 6%. The question is no longer only whether demand exists but who captures the profit and whether financing holds up; Dell itself said every AI order is vetted for the customer's access to capital. If Dell jumps after hours and is sold at the open, is the selling coming from positioning or from fundamentals? The discussion button is on the last page.
